query:
UPDATE kanban_tasks SET
            title = CASE WHEN $1 = '' THEN title ELSE NULLIF($2, '')::text END,
            body = CASE WHEN $3 = $4 THEN body ELSE $5 END,
            assignee = CASE WHEN $6 = '' THEN assignee ELSE NULLIF($7, '')::text END,
            channel_id = CASE WHEN $8 = $9 THEN channel_id ELSE NULLIF($10, '')::text END,
            profile = CASE WHEN $11 = $12 THEN profile ELSE NULLIF($13, '')::text END,
            priority = CASE WHEN $14 = -999999::bigint THEN priority::bigint ELSE $15 END,
            status = CASE WHEN $16 = '' THEN status ELSE $17 END,
            archived = $18,
            template = CASE WHEN $19 = $20 THEN template ELSE NULLIF($21, '')::text END,
            toolset = CASE WHEN $22 = $23 THEN toolset ELSE NULLIF($24, '')::text END,
            plan = $25,
            workflow_id = CASE WHEN $26 = $27 THEN workflow_id ELSE NULLIF($28, '')::text END,
            board = CASE WHEN $29 = '' THEN board ELSE NULLIF($30, '')::text END,
            position = CASE
                WHEN $31 = -999999 THEN
                    CASE WHEN $32 != '' AND $33 != board THEN 0 ELSE position END
                ELSE $34
            END,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $35
